name: Interim Reply Prompt
description: System prompt for the predictive interim reply. While the learner is still speaking on a long turn, a fast model uses the partial transcript to draft one short, non-committal holding reply that the character speaks the instant the learner stops — masking the real reply's latency, then cut when the real reply begins. Editable under System Skills. Variables: {scenario_context}, {language_label}, {language_code}.
